narr: Thunderstorms developed along a cold front in Central Texas and moved toward the south into South Central Texas. Some of these storms produced damaging wind gusts and heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. FM 336 was covered with several feet of water near Kent Creek and along the West Frio River.
lsr: PHOTOS RECEIVED OF SEVERAL FEET OF WATER COVERING HWY 336 AND SURROUNDING BACK ROADS NEAR KENT CREEK AND ALONG THE WEST PRONG OF THE FRIO RIVER IN REAL COUNTY.
